pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives — the whole city of Jerusalem seen from across the valley in the late light, a towering bank of worked cream and grey cloud climbing the left side of a warm gold sky, a long brown city wall running right across the middle of the picture with a walled up gate in it, above the wall the packed roofs and white domes of the old city, the great blue and gold Dome of the Rock standing in the middle of its wide paved court with dark cypresses and a row of small arcades beside it, a green strip of grass along the top of the wall, below it the valley falling away in long bare olive brown slopes worked with terrace lines and scattered with small grey green olive trees, a little white domed tomb standing alone on the far slope, a white stony track winding up out of the valley toward us, a slender olive tree growing up the right edge of the picture, and in the foreground on the bare rock a small travelling party, one man riding a camel with a second camel behind him, a boy in a red cap walking at the head and another man in a blue robe standing beside them, their long shadows thrown out across the stones, he went out with his disciples across the kidron valley, where they entered a garden, …
pictures.name: pd_church_jerusalem_from_the_mount_of_olives

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Night Watch — an armed company coming forward out of a dark gateway at night, the whole upper part of the picture worked dark brown stone with a great arch, a carved shield hung high on the wall and a thicket of long pikes and halberds crossing the gloom at the right, the captain striding out at the left in a black coat with a wide black hat, a broad white pleated collar and a brilliant scarlet sash across his breast, his gloved hand thrown out open before him as he gives the order, his lieutenant beside him in a pale cream and gold buff coat with a steel gorget at the throat, a white silk sash wound about his waist, a tall gold hat with a white plume and a partizan held down at his side, behind them a press of men in steel helmets, burnished breastplates and wide plumed hats, one loading a long musket, one blowing the pan of another, one at the right pointing away with his arm up, faces half cut at the left crop edge, gold embroidery and polished steel catching the lantern light, and the pale stone pavement showing between their boots at the bottom, they arrived at the garden carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons, …
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_the_night_watch

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Taking of Christ — a close press of heads out of the dark at night, Christ at the middle in a crimson robe over a deep blue mantle, His face bowed and lit full on with the brows drawn together, the eyes cast down and the lips parted, His own hands locked together low in front of Him, Judas pushed right up against Him on the right in a red brown coat, bald and heavy browed with a thick dark beard, his face turned up close to Christ's cheek and his hand gripping Christ's shoulder hard, a man behind them holding a great crimson hood up over both their heads so that it fills the whole top of the picture like a canopy, a soldier at the right in black polished plate armour with a burnished steel sleeve and gauntlet reaching across the picture to take hold of Christ, another armoured man crowding in behind him, a young disciple at the left crop edge with his mouth open and both arms thrown up as he cries out, his green sleeve and red cloak flying, two more bare hands showing at the lower right corner, and the whole upper part of the picture simply black, jesus said, i am he, and judas his betrayer was standing there with them, …
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_the_taking_of_christ

pictures.scene: Bernhard Plockhorst, The Good Shepherd — one full height shepherd walking straight toward us down a stony track in the open country, a deep crimson robe belted at the waist and falling to his bare feet, a long pale grey mantle thrown over both shoulders and hanging in wide folds across his breast, a soft gold halo of light round his long auburn hair, his bearded face bent down and his eyes lowered, a small white lamb gathered up on his left arm with its legs hanging and its head turned out, his hand holding it close against him, a tall slender staff held upright in his other hand, the flock crowding in on both sides, three ewes and a curled horn ram pressed together at the left with their faces lifted toward him and one big ewe at the right walking beside his knee, worked grass and briars with green leaves spreading across the bottom of the picture over the bare brown earth and loose stones of the track, a green bank with tall thin trees at the left and a flat pale lake and far shore at the right, and only a narrow band of pale blue sky along the top, so if you are looking for me, let these men go, …
pictures.name: pd_plockhorst_the_good_shepherd

pictures.scene: Bartolome Bermejo, Saint Michael Triumphant over the Devil — a tall panel on a tooled gold ground worked all over with a stamped foliage pattern, the archangel standing full height in the middle in burnished gilt plate armour, a fluted breastplate and skirt, mail at the throat and under the arms, long pointed gilt sabatons sewn with pearls, a dark green sash across his hips, his young beardless face bent down with the eyes lowered and fair curling hair falling to his neck, great spread wings behind him worked in gold, orange, scarlet and dark green, his right arm raised high above his head gripping the hilt of a long sword whose blade runs out of the top corner of the picture, his left hand holding a round gold and crystal orb set in a wide jewelled rim, an enormous crimson silk mantle lined with gold brocade billowing out behind him and filling the whole upper left of the panel, and under his feet a scaled dragon devil sprawled on its back on the brown earth, horned and bat eared with red eyes, its jaws open on rows of teeth, a clawed foot thrown up and a long barbed tail curling away, a kneeling donor at the lower left in a tall black cap and a silver grey damask gown holding an open book with his face lifted to the angel, small plants and tufts of grass worked round them, then simon peter drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, …
pictures.name: pd_bermejo_saint_michael_triumphant_over_the_devil

pictures.scene: Juarez, The Prayer in the Garden — a warm brown evening garden with Christ kneeling at the right in the middle of the picture, His body turned toward us and His bearded face lifted up with the eyes raised and the brows drawn, a thin gold halo of fine rays about His head, a rose pink tunic catching the light across the shoulder and a deep crimson red mantle falling from His waist and spreading out in heavy folds on the ground all round His knees, both hands opened wide and held out empty before Him, an angel standing in the sky at the upper left with great dark wings spread behind him, fair curling hair, a pale blue grey tunic with wide sleeves and green hose, holding out in both hands a tall gold chalice that catches the light, banks of cream and grey cloud lit from behind and a bare gold sky at the top left, a great dark olive brown rock and a tangle of dark leaves filling the whole right side above Him, and at the lower left one apostle sprawled fast asleep on the ground in a dull red cloak with his bald head fallen over and his hands slack, worked grass and a pale earth bank running across the bottom, shall i not drink the cup the father has given me, …
pictures.name: pd_juarez_prayer_in_the_garden

pictures.scene: Duccio, Christ Before Annas — a tall panel showing the whole house at once in two storeys of worked pink and tan stone, in the upper room the high priest seated at the left on a carved stone throne in a scarlet mantle over a dark green gown with a white head cloth and a long grey beard, leaning forward with his hand thrown out in accusation, Christ standing in the middle of the room in a deep blue black mantle over a vermilion tunic with a gold halo, His hands crossed quietly in front of Him, His head turned toward the priest and His bare feet on the floor, a guard gripping His arm and a press of soldiers crowding in behind Him in tan and coral tunics with high white helmets, round shields and a thicket of lances, one man at the back with his arm raised, two more elders standing at the far left, a dark coffered ceiling across the top and an open arched doorway at the right, and in the courtyard below Peter seated on a round stool in a green mantle with a gold halo, his hand lifted flat in denial and his bare feet on the ground, a ring of ten and more servants and officers crowded round him in coral and brown cloaks and white head cloths, a small charcoal fire of red embers and sticks burning at the bottom of the picture, a maid in a coral gown and white veil striding in from the left with her arm stretched out pointing at him, and a long flight of pale stone steps running up the wall between the two storeys, they brought him first to annas, …
pictures.name: pd_duccio_christ_before_annas

pictures.scene: Pieter de Hooch, The Courtyard of a House in Delft — a small brick courtyard in the afternoon sun, a tall red and white brick archway filling the whole left side with a carved stone plaque set into the wall above it and a lantern hanging inside the arch, through the opening a pale passage running back to a second arch, a window, a wooden rail and a strip of sunlit street, a woman standing in there with her back fully turned in a black jacket and a rust brown skirt, on the right of the picture a dim wooden porch with a heavy grey plank door standing open on its hinges, a worn stone step and an old vine trained over a wooden trellis across the top with small yellow leaves hanging down, a young mother coming out of the porch in a white cap and a white kerchief crossed at the throat with a dark bodice, a long black apron and a wide blue skirt, holding a shallow dish in one hand and leading a little girl by the other, the child in a white cap, a pale brown pinafore over a gold yellow skirt and a white cloth in her fist, looking straight up into her face, a long wooden ladder leaning across the porch, a wooden bucket standing in the corner and a birch broom lying on the ground, and the whole bottom half of the picture a floor of pale worn brick cobbles with a strip of blue sky and a dark tree at the top, but peter stood outside at the door, …
pictures.name: pd_de_hooch_courtyard_of_a_house_in_delft

pictures.scene: Gerrit van Honthorst, The Denial of Saint Peter — three faces lit by one candle out of a black night, the whole upper part of the picture simply dark, a young servant girl at the left with a white and rose striped cloth wound about her head and falling on her shoulder, her face turned up and lit full on with her lips parted as she speaks, one hand holding a turned wooden candlestick low in front of her so the flame throws the light upward, a dark red sleeved bodice over a blue gown, a soldier behind her in a studded steel helmet and a gorget with a white and green striped doublet, his face lit sideways with a dark moustache and his eyes on the old man, a long pike held upright in his fist, his other arm reaching across and his gloved hand pointing straight at the old man's breast, and at the right Peter standing half turned with grey hair and a short white beard, his lined face lit full on and his brows raised, a heavy ochre cloak wrapped over a dark coat and drawn across him, one hand laid flat on his own chest and the other opened out wide in denial, aren't you also one of this man's disciples, …
pictures.name: pd_honthorst_the_denial_of_saint_peter

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel, The Sermon of Saint John the Baptist — a whole countryside of people gathered in a wood to hear one man speak, the preacher standing small in the upper middle of the picture on the rising ground in a plain brown robe with long hair and a beard, one hand lifted at his breast and the other thrown out open as he speaks, a dark mass of great trees closing right over the top of the picture with thin trunks and a few gaps of pale evening sky, two boys climbed up into the branches to see over the heads, and below him a crowd of hundreds banked up the slope and filling the whole picture, rank behind rank of small faces turned toward him in white hoods, linen coifs, black caps, red and orange cloaks and dark coats, and in the near foreground enormous backs and shoulders seen squarely from behind, a man in a pale yellow cloak at the left, another in a dark coat with a basket hat and a long staff sitting on the ground, a big figure in a red brown mantle in the middle, a woman at the right in a great cream and red striped cloak with a wide straw hat on her back and a small child on her arm, a man in a black coat with a white ruff turning his lined face out at us beside her, and worked dark earth and grass running across the bottom, i have spoken openly to the world, …
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_prediking

pictures.scene: Albrecht Durer, Christ Among the Doctors — a close press of heads, hands and books crowded right up against us out of a near black ground, the boy Christ in the middle in a blue green robe with a fine gold edge, long waving reddish gold hair falling on both shoulders, a thin halo of ruled gold rays behind His head, His face bent a little and the eyes lowered as He counts off an argument on His fingers, both hands lifted open in front of His breast, a very old doctor crowding in at the right with a bald lined forehead, hollow cheeks and an open mouth with one tooth showing, a dark red mantle over a black gown, his two pale bony hands reaching across into the middle of the picture and arguing back point for point, another old man below him with a long white beard and a great weathered hand holding a book open, a third doctor at the upper left half cut by the crop edge with a stubbled face and a finger laid to his lips, holding up a small written book, a fourth at the lower left with a worn hand on a clasped volume, a grey curl of hair showing between them, and three or four heavy brown bound books with cut pages and gilt bosses filling the whole bottom of the picture, why are you asking me, ask those who heard my message, …
pictures.name: pd_durer_doctors

pictures.scene: Paolo Veronese, Saints Mark and Marcellian Led to Martyrdom — a bright courtyard of worked white stone, a heavy pier and a carved doorway filling the upper left, a long balustrade running across the picture behind with pale draped onlookers leaning over it and a strip of blue grey sky above, an aged man standing at the left in a dark blue mantle over an olive robe with a long white beard and a bald lined head, leaning forward and reaching out one hand in appeal, two women kneeling at his feet in the bottom corner, one in a deep blue gown with a white ermine lined cape over her shoulders and her head bowed, the other in white and gold with her face turned up, a boy in a red sleeved doublet and red hose crouched beside them and a child looking out between, and at the right three men standing close together, an officer in a burnished steel helmet with a tall blue plume and a great green and gold cloak over his shoulder, his hand held out level as he answers, a heavy bearded man behind him in a gilt gorget and rose pink hose, and a young man at the edge in crimson scale armour with gold bands and a studded skirt, a low stone rail and small figures in white turbans in the courtyard between them, then annas sent him, still bound, to caiaphas the high priest, …
pictures.name: pd_veronese_ketenen

pictures.scene: Paul Delaroche, Joan of Arc Interrogated in Prison — a bare stone cell with the whole upper part of the picture simply black, an old churchman seated at the left and filling the lower two thirds, an enormous scarlet robe falling from his shoulders to the floor with a scarlet shoulder cape, a round scarlet cap on his head and a heavy gold cross hanging on a chain against his breast, a white pleated sleeve showing at the wrist, his lined yellow face turned sharply round and his eyes fixed on the prisoner, one bony hand gripping the arm of his chair and the other thrown out flat over his knee as he presses the question, a dark sliver of a second man at the far left crop edge holding up a written paper, and at the right the young prisoner sitting up on a low bed of straw with a chain and an iron band locked about her wrists, a plain white shift with close dark sleeves, dark hair falling loose on her shoulders, her hands clasped tight together and her face lifted quietly toward him, loose straw hanging over the edge of the bed, worked grey stone wall behind her and a bare stone floor across the bottom, he denied it and said, i am not, …
pictures.name: pd_delaroche_verhoor

pictures.scene: El Greco, The Tears of Saint Peter — one old man seen close up at half length out of a dark brown ground, his grey hair swept back and a thick white beard about a worn lined face, his head tipped back and his eyes lifted and brimming so the light catches the wet of them, his mouth a little open, a great golden yellow mantle wrapped over his shoulder and across his breast in heavy folds with a deep blue green robe showing at the other shoulder and arm, his throat and the top of his chest bare above it, both hands clasped hard together in front of him with the fingers locked and the bare forearms crossing the picture, two iron keys hanging on a cord from his wrist at the lower right, trailing stems of green ivy coming down over the dark rock on both sides at the top, and a pale rift of grey and white light opening at the far left edge, peter denied it once more, and immediately a rooster crowed, …
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_saint_peter_in_tears

pictures.scene: Werner van den Valckert, The Regents of the Kramersgilde — two officials sitting behind a table in a dim panelled room, both in heavy black doublets with wide white ruffs at the throat and tall flat crowned black hats, looking straight out of the picture at whoever has just come in, the nearer one with a red brown moustache and beard and his brows drawn together, one hand flat on the table and the other lifted off it as he speaks, the second man beside him turning his head toward us with his hand on an open ledger and a quill laid on a sheet of paper beside a round black inkwell, a large curling written document held down on the table between them, a brass balance with two shallow pans hanging on a chain from the ceiling in the dark behind, a hand and sleeve of a third man entering at the right edge and another hand at the lower left corner, and the whole bottom of the picture filled by a thick table carpet worked in orange, gold and deep blue, what accusation are you bringing against this man, …
pictures.name: pd_valckert_regents_kramergild

pictures.scene: Vasily Surikov, The Morning of the Streltsy Execution — a great square at first light packed solid with people, the painted onion domes and tiered brick of the cathedral rising across the whole top of the picture under a thin pale grey sky, heads and fur caps banked up behind a low white wall, pikes and halberd blades standing up out of the press, rough carts drawn in among the crowd with condemned men sitting in them in long white shirts, each holding a small lit candle in his fist, one of them black bearded with his head thrust forward, an old white bearded man held by the arm beside him, women in red and yellow kerchiefs crying out, a small girl in a red headscarf at the front with her face turned to us, an old woman in black sunk down on the ground with her hands hanging over her knees, and the whole bottom of the picture churned brown mud with cart wheels sunk in it, we are not permitted to execute anyone, …
pictures.name: pd_surikov_the_morning_of_the_streltsy_execution

pictures.scene: Jan Gossaert, The Adoration of the Kings — one of the three kings standing at the middle of the picture in a long robe of cloth of gold worked all over with a fine pattern, a tall jewelled gold crown set over a red and gold headband on his head, a pale blue silk mantle falling from his shoulder across his arm and down to the ground in a wide fringed end lettered in gold, a fur collar and a green sash under the gold, and a tall gilt vessel built like a little spired church held up in his hand, a fair haired young man beside him in a red cap and a brocaded blue, green and gold doublet over crimson, a servant in a great blue turban and another older face pressed in close behind them, a figure in red cut by the edge at the right, a small watching face at a window at the left, and behind all of them a wall of red brick and grey cut stone hung at the top with a white and blue banner and a green gold embroidered cloth, are you the king of the jews, …
pictures.name: pd_gossaert_the_adoration_of_the_kings

pictures.scene: Edward Hicks, The Peaceable Kingdom — a small child standing at the middle of a dark wood in a white shift with a wide frilled collar and a scarlet sash across it, a pale grey gauze wrap hanging from his shoulders, one bare arm laid along the back of a great tawny lion whose maned head comes to the child's waist and who looks quietly out of the picture, a brown ox pressing in behind the lion on the right, a lioness lying stretched out on the ground at the left with a small white lamb curled asleep in front of her paws, a white goat sitting on the grass at the right and a spotted leopard lying in the near corner with its head up, a near black mass of branches hung with vine leaves and little bunches of grapes closing right over the whole top of the picture, one pale opening of sky showing through far off at the left, and a bank of worked green grass running across the bottom, my kingdom is not of this world, …
pictures.name: pd_hicks_peaceable_kingdom

pictures.scene: Nikolai Ge, What Is Truth — two men standing apart in a bare hall with a worn red wall behind them, the Roman governor huge in the near foreground seen from behind, wrapped from shoulder to ankle in a heavy gold and olive toga bordered with a red band, his close cropped head turned so his face shows in profile with a short grey beard, his bare arm thrown out and the hand open as he asks, broad sunlight falling across him and running out over a floor of pale cracked hexagonal tiles, a hard black shadow lying from his feet into the middle of the picture, and Christ standing back against the wall in the shadow in a long dark worn robe with a brown mantle hanging from His shoulder, His hands down and His tired face lifted and quiet, what is truth, …
pictures.name: pd_ge_what_is_truth

pictures.scene: Jorg Breu, The Crowd Shouting Against Him — a press of men crowded up close against us and all shouting at once, a bishop at the left in a tall white mitre sewn with gold and green jewels and a pale yellow fringed cope over a green robe, his face set and both hands raised as he argues, an old man in front of him in a black cap and a wide white fur collar over a great crimson gown with black and gold embroidered sleeves, his head thrown back and his mouth open, a rolled paper gripped in his hand, a heavy bearded man in a gold crown and a green robe shouting beside him, behind them a bank of furious faces in red hoods, a white turban and a green and black cap with their mouths wide, bare arms thrown up above their heads at the very top of the picture, a plain dark brown wall band down the left side and a pale stepped stone plinth in the lower corner, not this man, they shouted, but barabbas, …
pictures.name: pd_breu_de_menigte_roept_tegen_hem

lines.text: After Jesus had spoken these words, He went out with His disciples across the Kidron Valley, where they entered a garden.
Now Judas His betrayer also knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with His disciples.
So Judas brought a band of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees. They arrived at the garden carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.
Jesus, knowing all that was coming upon Him, stepped forward and asked them, Whom are you seeking?
Jesus of Nazareth, they answered. Jesus said, I am He. And Judas His betrayer was standing there with them.
When Jesus said, I am He, they drew back and fell to the ground.
So He asked them again, Whom are you seeking? Jesus of Nazareth, they answered.
I told you that I am He, Jesus replied. So if you are looking for Me, let these men go.
This was to fulfill the word He had spoken: I have not lost one of those You have given Me.
Then Simon Peter drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
Put your sword back in its sheath! Jesus said to Peter. Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given Me?
Then the band of soldiers, with its commander and the officers of the Jews, arrested Jesus and bound Him.
They brought Him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.
Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it would be better if one man died for the people.
Now Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Since that disciple was known to the high priest, he also went with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest.
But Peter stood outside at the door. Then the disciple who was known to the high priest went out and spoke to the doorkeeper, and brought Peter in.
At this, the servant girl watching the door said to Peter, Aren't you also one of this man's disciples? I am not, he answered.
Because it was cold, the servants and officers were standing around a charcoal fire they had made to keep warm. And Peter was also standing with them, warming himself.
Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and His teaching.
I have spoken openly to the world, Jesus answered. I always taught in the synagogues and at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.
Why are you asking Me? Ask those who heard My message. Surely they know what I said.
When Jesus had said this, one of the officers standing nearby slapped Him in the face and said, Is this how You answer the high priest?
Jesus replied, If I said something wrong, testify as to what was wrong. But if I spoke correctly, why did you strike Me?
Then Annas sent Him, still bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.
Simon Peter was still standing and warming himself. So they asked him, Aren't you also one of His disciples? He denied it and said, I am not.
One of the high priest's servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, asked, Didn't I see you with Him in the garden?
Peter denied it once more, and immediately a rooster crowed.
Then they led Jesus away from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. By now it was early morning, and the Jews did not enter the Praetorium, to avoid being defiled and unable to eat the Passover.
So Pilate went out to them and asked, What accusation are you bringing against this man?
If He were not a criminal, they replied, we would not have handed Him over to you.
You take Him and judge Him by your own law, Pilate told them. We are not permitted to execute anyone, the Jews replied.
This was to fulfill the word that Jesus had spoken to indicate the kind of death He was going to die.
Pilate went back into the Praetorium, summoned Jesus, and asked Him, Are You the King of the Jews?
Are you saying this on your own, Jesus asked, or did others tell you about Me?
Am I a Jew? Pilate replied. Your own people and chief priests handed You over to me. What have You done?
Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world; if it were, My servants would fight to prevent My arrest by the Jews. But now My kingdom is not of this realm.

Then You are a king! Pilate said. You say that I am a king, Jesus answered. For this reason I was born and have come into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to My voice.
What is truth? Pilate asked. And having said this, he went out again to the Jews and told them, I find no basis for a charge against Him.
But it is your custom that I release to you one prisoner at the Passover. So then, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?
Not this man, they shouted, but Barabbas! Now Barabbas was an insurrectionist.
